statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The study is to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to neurological symptoms
The patient has no other applicable primary coverage
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer
